name: Stevenage Newcomers Sunday 2024
information:
This competition is targeted a first-time competitors and less experienced competitors, but everyone is welcome. Medals will be awarded to the fastest newcomers.

**PLEASE NOTE**: This is a Series Competition with Stevenage Newcomers Saturday 2024. You may only attend ONE of these competitions. Please see further details on the [Series Competition](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/StevenageNewcomersSunday2024#36087-series-competition) tab.

Please read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering.

**Spectators may attend for free. There is no need to book!**
